results.title: Colour identity within a commander's colours
results.question: Which Oracle cards have a colour identity that fits inside an Esper (WUB) commander's identity?
results.note: subCombinationOf is a true partial order, safe to traverse (contrast with Tagger parents).
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?name ?identity WHERE {
  ?card a smtg:OracleCard ; smtg:name ?name ; smtg:hasColorIdentity ?ci .
  ?ci smtg:subCombinationOf <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/color-combination/WUB> ; skos:prefLabel ?identity .

results.title: Several faces on one physical side

results.note: uses the layout → face-configuration mapping instead of memorising layout codes.
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?name ?layoutLabel (COUNT(?f) AS ?faces) WHERE {
  ?card smtg:name ?name ; smtg:hasLayout ?layout ; smtg:hasFace ?f .
  ?layout smtg:impliesFaceConfiguration <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/face-configuration/same-side-parts> ; skos:prefLabel ?layoutLabel .

results.title: Printings sharing an illustration

results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>

results.title: Claims by kind, authority and source
results.question: How many claims of each kind exist, with which epistemic status, from which source dataset?
results.note: documented combos, tag beliefs, authoritative legality reports and statistical observations stay distinguishable.
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?claimClass ?status ?dataset (COUNT(?c) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?c a ?cls ; smtg:hasEpistemicStatus/skos:notation ?status ; smtg:observedIn/smtg:snapshotOf/rdfs:label ?dataset .
  ?cls rdfs:subClassOf* smtg:Claim ; rdfs:label ?claimClass .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c a ?sub . ?sub rdfs:subClassOf ?cls . FILTER(?sub != ?cls) }
} GROUP BY ?claimClass ?status ?dataset ORDER BY DESC(?n)

results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?name ?set ?flavor WHERE {
  ?printing smtg:isPrintingOf/smtg:name ?name ; smtg:inSet/smtg:setCode ?set ; smtg:hasPrintedFace/smtg:hasPrintedText ?ft .
  ?ft a smtg:FlavorText ; smtg:textValue ?flavor .
} ORDER BY ?name ?set

results.title: Subtypes with their scheme
results.question: For every creature face, which subtypes does it have and from which type-qualified scheme?
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?faceName ?subtype ?scheme WHERE {
  ?f smtg:hasCardType <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/card-type/creature> ; smtg:name ?faceName ; smtg:hasSubtype ?st .
  ?st skos:prefLabel ?subtype ; skos:inScheme/rdfs:label ?scheme .
} ORDER BY ?faceName ?subtype

results.title: Ambiguous subtype words
results.question: Which subtype words occur in more than one type-qualified scheme (same label, different concepts)?
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?word (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?schemeLabel; separator=' | ') AS ?schemes) WHERE {
  ?c a/rdfs:subClassOf smtg:Subtype ; skos:notation ?word ; skos:inScheme/rdfs:label ?schemeLabel .
} GROUP BY ?word HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) > 1) ORDER BY ?word

results.title: Historic faces (type group, CR 700.6)
results.question: Which faces are historic (legendary, artifact or Saga), and through which member of the group?
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?face ?via WHERE {
  <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/type-group/historic> skos:member ?m .
  ?f smtg:hasSupertype|smtg:hasCardType|smtg:hasSubtype ?m ; smtg:name ?face .
  ?m skos:prefLabel ?via .
} ORDER BY ?face
